newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air expands electronic ticketing.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air expands electronic ticketing.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said it has extended its electronic ticketing to include flights to and from San Juan and the Virgin Islands.

Delta customers using electronic ticketing in San Juan may receive a boarding authorization at the airport ticket counters, gate counters, flight information counters, and Crown Rooms Clubs. However, baggage must be checked at the ticket counters, the airline said.
In St. Thomas and St. Croix, all passengers must check in at the ticketing counter to pre-clear with customs.

"Earlier this year, we introduced electronic ticketing to all 50 states, and we are excited about expanding our electronic ticketing service to San Juan and the Virgin Islands," said Lee Macenczak, vice president of reservation sales and distribution planning.
